data.jd_text:
**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Director of Project Execution** 
 who will
 **report directly to the Executive Management** 
 and oversee multiple airport BHS and MHS projects. You will provide guidance and leadership to the Project Execution and Site Management teams, foster collaboration across internal functions and external stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on\-time, on\-budget, contract compliant, and to the required quality through to handover.
   

  

**What are my responsibilities?**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of airport BHS/MHS programs, ensuring safe, on\-budget, contract\-compliant execution.
* Serve as senior client and stakeholder lead, aligning airport authorities/operators, consultants/PMCs, contractors, and internal teams.
* Own the full lifecycle from engineering coordination through installation, integration, testing, commissioning, ORAT, and handover to Service.
* Drive strong project governance (steerco, reviews, workshops), ensuring clear decisions, actions, and follow\-up.
* Manage portfolio performance across multi\-site/multi\-country matrix teams; control KPIs, risk, change, and escalations, including recovery/turnaround.
* Ensure effective site execution in live airport environments, including M\&E installation, upgrades, brownfield works, and system interface management.
* Ensure completeness and quality of technical/contract documentation and reporting across the project lifecycle.
* Lead successful handovers to Life\-Cycle Services, ensuring continuity, training, spares, warranty transition, and sign\-off.
* Support Sales \& Bid activities to develop opportunities and ensure executable delivery strategies and resourcing inputs.
* Build and lead high\-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**What do I need to qualify for the role?**
* 10\+ years delivering complex engineering/automation/site projects; strong ownership of cost, schedule, quality, and safety.
* Proven leadership in multi\-stakeholder environments with strong client\-facing and executive communication capability.
* Strong experience in airport BHS or MHS systems including site execution and commissioning; ORAT exposure is a plus.
* Solid understanding of automation integration environments (mechanical/electrical, PLC/SCADA/controls, interfaces).
* Strong commercial and contractual discipline: change control, risk/opportunity management, claims awareness.
* Proficient in project tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, MS Office; Jira/Confluence is a plus).
* Willingness to travel and operate in dynamic airport environments.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview
 
 :** 




 The Projects Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and successful delivery of all projects within the organization. The role oversees the full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through execution and handover, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Projects Director operates as the senior authority across all project teams, aligning engineering, procurement, commercial, and site operations with the company’s business objectives and premium construction standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 :** 




 Strategic Leadership \& Portfolio Management
 


* Lead and oversee the entire project portfolio from inception to final handover.
* Define project governance structures, reporting frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
* Align project execution strategy with corporate financial and operational objectives.
* Review and approve master schedules, budgets, and procurement strategies.
* Establish project performance KPIs, including cost variance, schedule variance, productivity, and margin.



 Project Execution \& Operational Excellence
 


* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations and company standards.
* Monitor progress across multiple projects and intervene proactively to resolve bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective coordination between engineering, procurement, commercial, and site teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in construction methodologies and resource utilization.
* Ensure strict adherence to approved drawings, specifications, and quality benchmarks.



 Financial \& Commercial Management
 


* Oversee project budgeting, forecasting, and cost control mechanisms.
* Review and approve major variations, subcontractor agreements, and commercial negotiations.
* Safeguard project profitability, cash flow, and margin performance.
* Monitor procurement efficiency and material cost optimization.
* Ensure proper contract administration and claims management practices.



 Risk, Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with UAE construction regulations, safety standards, and contractual requirements.
* Implement enterprise\-level risk mitigation strategies across all active projects.
* Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture with zero\-incident objectives.
* Ensure implementation of quality assurance and quality control systems across sites.



 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and evaluate Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Engineering teams.
* Act as the executive representative for clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and resolution of concerns.
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration to ensure seamless project execution.
* Support succession planning and capability development within the project's function.



 Personal Attributes:
 


* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to manage a diverse team and maintain project momentum.
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
* Results\-driven with a high accountability and ownership mindset.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented with a problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Strong commitment to safety and quality on\-site.



  





**Requirements
 
 :** 



* A minimum of 15 to 20 years of progressive experience in construction project management, with a proven track record working with reputable contracting companies in the UAE.
* Proven experience in managing luxury projects,
 **including high\-end villas** 
 , with a strong understanding of premium construction standards and finishes.
* Demonstrated success in leading multi\-project portfolios within the UAE or GCC region.



  





**Qualification
 
 :** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field from a recognized university.
* Master’s Degree or professional certifications (PMP, RICS, etc.) preferred.

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:**

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of Complex Change is accountable for the hands‑on execution and successful delivery of RAKBANK’s most complex, cross‑functional, and strategically critical transformation programmes. The role owns end‑to‑end delivery outcomes—time, scope, and budget—across multi‑platform, multi‑vendor, and multi‑year initiatives with board‑level visibility and CBUAE scrutiny. Acting as the bank’s delivery field commander, the incumbent manages complexity, controls scope, and drives proactive risk mitigation. The role serves as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and offshore delivery teams, ensuring execution quality and accountability. It requires deep, proven experience in leading large‑scale banking transformations to measurable outcomes.
 



  





  





**What You will Do** 



* Own executive delivery accountability for RAKBANK’s most complex transformation programmes across core banking, digital, payments, and infrastructure.
* Ensure programmes are delivered to committed scope, timelines, and budgets with clear, outcome‑based ownership.
* Lead proactive risk identification and mitigation through deep upfront assessments and a live, senior‑reviewed RAID framework.
* Enforce rigorous scope management and prevent scope creep via disciplined change control and executive escalation.
* Act as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and vendors, ensuring contractual accountability and milestone delivery.
* Lead and align Offshore Development Centres and offshore delivery teams to programme plans, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Design and mobilise complex, multi‑year programme structures, governance forums, and inter‑workstream dependencies.
* Chair programme steering and governance forums, resolving blockers and escalating issues to CTO, ExCo, and CEO as required.
* Coordinate regulatory, audit, compliance, and risk engagement for programmes under CBUAE scrutiny.
* Produce board‑quality, risk‑adjusted programme reporting and build delivery leadership capability across programme managers and change leads.



  





**What You Will Brin** 



* 20\+ years of progressive technology and transformation leadership, with a minimum of 5 years in an EVP, MD, Programme Director, or CXO\-adjacent delivery leadership role within a bank or globally regulated financial institution.
* Demonstrated track record of personally leading and successfully completing multi\-year, cross\-platform transformation programmes in banking — specifically including core banking migration or major platform upgrade, payments modernisation, or digital platform transformation.
* Expert\-level command of upfront risk management, scope control, and delivery governance in complex, multi\-vendor programme environments — with evidence of having prevented or resolved scope creep and delivery crises in prior engagement.
* Proven experience managing Tier\-1 vendor relationships and ODC/offshore delivery partnerships within programme scope — holding external parties to contractual accountability and delivery standard.
* Expert command of enterprise programme governance frameworks (MSP, PMI\-PgMP, or equivalent) and the ability to adapt these pragmatically to the pace and constraints of live banking transformation.
* Experience engaging with central bank regulators (CBUAE, FCA, MAS, or equivalent) on technology change submissions and supervisory engagement, in partnership with governance and compliance function.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA, MSP Practitioner, or PMI\-PgMP certification highly preferred.



  





**What We are Not Looking for:** 




 ❌ A coordinator or status‑reporting PMO profile that tracks plans but does not personally own delivery outcomes, risk decisions, and executive accountability.
 



 ❌ A leader who reacts to issues after escalation, rather than proactively identifying, structuring, and mitigating complex delivery risks upfront.
 



 ❌ A purely theoretical transformation expert with “exposure” to large programmes, but without proven, hands‑on experience delivering multi‑platform banking transformations under board and regulatory scrutiny.

**Job Summary** 




 The Project Management Director is responsible for managing and delivering transformation projects and other strategic initiatives under Transformation \& PMO. Ensure that projects align with organizational goals, adhere to project management best practices, and drive continuous improvement in business processes. Additionally, project planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, and risk management to ensure timely and successful project completion.
 



  





  





**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 



1. **Project Planning \& Execution** 
 : Develop comprehensive project plans, set clear deliverables, and ensure projects are executed within scope, timeline, and budget
2. **Stakeholder Coordination** 
 : Engage with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment of project objectives, expectations, and key milestones
3. **Transformation Project Management** 
 : Lead transformation initiatives by implementing structured methodologies to optimize efficiency and enhance operational effectiveness
4. **Resource Allocation** 
 : Manage project resources effectively, ensuring optimal utilization of personnel, tools, and financial resources
5. **Risk \& Issue Management** 
 : Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and proactively address challenges to ensure project success
6. **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting** 
 : Track project progress, generate status reports and provide insights to leadership on project performance metrics
7. **Governance \& Compliance** 
 : Ensure adherence to PMO governance frameworks, organizational policies, and relevant compliance requirements throughout project execution
8. **Change Management** 
 : Support the adoption of new processes and technologies by implementing management strategies that facilitate smooth transitions
9. **Continuous Improvement**

**About Us**
 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organizations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
   

  

**Line Of Service Overview**
 Our Deals Line of Service helps clients navigate complex transactions, from strategy through execution. We deliver insights and solutions that create value across the deal lifecycle, supporting organizations in achieving sustainable growth and transformation.
   

  

**Business Unit Overview**
 The Delivering Deal Value (DDV) team within Deals Strategy \& Operations provides strategic and operational advice to investors, governments, and major corporations. We focus on operational integration, carve\-outs, and value creation to help clients realize synergies and achieve their strategic objectives.
   

  

**How You’ll Contribute**
 As a Deals Delivering Value Director focused on the Technology, Media and Telecommunications (TMT) sector, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Overseeing post\-merger integrations, identifying and leveraging synergies to enhance value creation and ensure successful integration of acquisitions for clients in the TMT sectors
* Providing expert advice on setting deal strategies, managing post\-deal execution, and supporting operational due diligence for potential acquisitions
* Assisting government entities and other clients with Day 1 readiness activities to ensure smooth transitions and operational continuity post\-acquisition
* Managing complex projects, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery while leading and coaching teams of consultants
* Cultivating and managing relationships with key stakeholders, including government officials, industry leaders, and senior executives
* Leading business development efforts, including drafting proposals and marketing materials to secure new mandates
* Identifying and pursuing opportunities to sell additional services and collaborating with the DDV team and the wider PwC network
* Mentoring and developing junior team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance work environment


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience leading value creation initiatives across the deal lifecycle (pre\-deal, carve\-out, post\-acquisition, and exit) for TMT assets
* Digital infrastructure and AI experience (data centers, fibre, towers, cloud platforms) is a must\-have for this role
* Developed and executed 100\-day plans and full value creation roadmaps aligned to investment theses and shareholder objective
* Identify and deliver enhancement opportunities, including revenue growth, cost optimization, and operational efficiency
* Lead synergy assessment and integration planning for buy\-and\-build strategies within the TMT ecosystem
* Proven experience working within the Middle East region, with a strong understanding of regional market dynamics
* Expertise in executing and program managing post\-merger integrations and carve\-outs across large and small transactions
* Strong track record in delivering transaction\-related services such as operational due diligence, post\-merger integration, carve\-outs, and operational turnarounds
* Deep understanding of investment strategies, deal structuring, and the M\&A process, with the ability to provide actionable insights and solutions
* Excellent leadership and team management skills, with experience guiding projects from inception to completion
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build credibility with senior stakeholders
* Arabic language proficiency is required
* Your flexibility to trav el 30\-40% of the time. This means we may require you to work away from your base office location on a regular basis, and frequent overnight stays may be required. Where possible, we will take your preferences into account and strike a balance between meeting your career development/personal needs and those of the business and our clients


**How You’ll Make a Difference**
 At PwC Middle East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC**
 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job – you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East .

**Job Purpose:** 




 As an IT Engineer, you will design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot IT systems, networks, and infrastructure across all business units within the Group.
 



  





 You will ensure the functionality, security, and efficiency of the organization’s technology infrastructure, supporting smooth business operations and resolving technical issues related to systems, networks, cloud environments, and cybersecurity.
 







  





**Responsibilities:** 




**1\. IT Infrastructure \& System Administration** 



* Manage and maintain enterprise hardware, software, servers, and network infrastructure.
* Perform installation, configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management of IT systems.
* Support virtualization platforms, server environments, and enterprise applications to maintain high system availability.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, system health, and network reliability.



  





**2\. Cloud \& Hybrid Environment Management** 



* Administer and support cloud\-based productivity and collaboration platforms within hybrid IT environments.
* Assist in cloud integration, infrastructure modernization, and deployment of new technologies.
* Support resource provisioning, cloud migrations, and operational scalability initiatives.



  





**3\. IT Security \& Compliance** 



* Implement IT security policies, access controls, and operational procedures to safeguard organizational infrastructure and business data.
* Manage firewall configurations, VPN access, endpoint protection, and email security solutions.
* Ensure adherence to cybersecurity best practices and support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture.



  





**4\. System Maintenance \& Operational Support** 



* Perform regular system maintenance, updates, patch management, and preventive troubleshooting.
* Manage backup operations, disaster recovery procedures, and business continuity measures.
* Provide technical support to users by resolving hardware, software, connectivity, and application\-related issues efficiently.



  





**5\. Network \& Connectivity Management** 



* Manage network infrastructure components including connectivity, wireless solutions, remote access, and communication systems.
* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity or infrastructure\-related issues.
* Support network security and ensure stable and secure communication environments.



  





**6\. Automation \& Digital Workplace Solutions** 



* Utilize AI\-powered productivity and automation tools to improve operational workflows and administrative efficiency.
* Support digital workplace and knowledge management platforms to enhance collaboration and communication.
* Assist in workflow optimization and infrastructure process improvements.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Vendor Coordination** 



* Collaborate with internal teams to integrate new technologies and systems into the existing infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for procurement, maintenance, and project implementation.
* Support office infrastructure setup, IT asset deployment, and employee onboarding/offboarding processes.



  





**8\. Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and infrastructure records.
* Document IT procedures, configurations, and support processes to maintain operational knowledge.
* Prepare performance reports and provide recommendations for infrastructure improvements.







  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in IT support, system administration, network administration, or a similar role.
* Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Security\+, or Microsoft Azure Fundamentals are preferred.
* Experience working with enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, and network management environments is highly preferred.







  





**Technical Skills:** 



* Proficiency in Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems.
* Strong knowledge of networking protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and related technologies.
* Experience with server administration, virtualization technologies, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protection, and cybersecurity practices.
* Experience in backup management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.

**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Moove is transforming mobility to make it safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while providing economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Performance \& Strategy at Moove is responsible for driving business performance, planning discipline, and execution across markets. This role owns the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including running business reviews, leading planning processes, and identifying and driving resolution of key performance issues in partnership with market and functional leaders. In parallel, you will act as a strategic partner to local teams, supporting critical decisions on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion, while aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. **Description**

 Amazon Now (A\-Now) team is looking to for a business/product leader to drive A\-Now design for a seamless customer shopping journey. This role will be a combination of product ownership and business strategy ownership to ensure customers in the region have the best grocery shopping experience when they order from Amazon. In this regard, the role is a blend of the following dimensions \- business strategy, product development and management, program value assurance, operational excellence and entrepreneurship.
   

  

 What we're looking for A product leader who is equally comfortable defining a 2\-year vision and rolling up their sleeves on execution detail — someone who can align Tech, Marketing, Category, and Finance behind a shared outcome, navigate ambiguity across three markets, and hold themselves accountable to business results, not just feature delivery.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* MENA A\-Now plans to invest millions in coupons to acquire, engage and reward customers to drive basket\-building missions. * Ensure staff are equipped with the training, tools, and support required to deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced MENA environment.
* Foster multidisciplinary collaboration across all internal disciplines and external project and client teams.


**Operational management**
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of the Built Environment business, including project delivery oversight, utilisation, workforce planning, quality management, and budget performance.

* Drive consistency in delivery methodologies, design management, and project controls.

**Sales and financial performance**
* Support the achievement of sales, revenue, margin, and cash performance targets for the Built Environment business.
* Monitor business and project financial performance, analyse variances, and implement corrective actions where required.
* Support and review scope changes, variation orders, claims positions, and commercial negotiations in conjunction with project leaders.
* Contribute to pipeline conversion by ensuring robust delivery planning, partner strategies, and resourcing confidence at bid stage.

**Optimise operations**
* Implement measures that improve value creation, operational efficiency, and profitability across the Built Environment portfolio.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience

* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many futureproofing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, and Sandbox Dubai. DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of unlimited imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



  





 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation recently launched Sandbox Dubai, a Regulatory Sandbox that centers around four key themes: Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology. We would like to invite talented and experienced individuals to join our dynamic team as we embark on this journey.
 



  





 As we embrace the challenges and opportunities of the modern regulatory landscape, we are seeking talented individuals who are eager to contribute their expertise and creativity to the Sandbox Dubai initiatives. We aim to explore novel solutions, foster collaboration across sectors, and pave the way for transformative changes that benefit both consumers and industries of Dubai.
 



  





 In the broader context of Sandbox Dubai, the Project Manager reports to the Head of Operations of Sandbox Dubai and will collaborate closely with the Sandbox team leads in Strategy, Policy, and Partnerships.
 



  





**Project Manager** 




  





 As a Project Manager within Sandbox Dubai, you will lead and manage sandbox programs and projects, including regulatory experiments, industry pilots, and innovation frameworks from concept to delivery or handover. You will manage multiple sandbox projects, deploy and enhance processes, coordinate cross\-functional teams, drive project timelines, engage diverse Future Foundation’s strategic goals.
 



  





**Project Management** 




  




* Full Project Lifecycle: Manage the full project cycle including managing projects timelines, budgets, milestones, setting objectives, monitoring and tracking progress, post project analysis and reporting.
* Project Development: Pitch sandbox projects with business cases, feasibility reports, and risk assessments tailored to sandbox\-specific initiatives.
* Sandbox Design \& Execution: Develop sandbox programs focused on regulatory experiments, technology validation, and proof\-of\-concept pilots across Sandbox priority areas (Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology).
* Global Tech Monitoring: Track international regulatory and innovation trends in key priority sectors to enhance the design of future sandbox initiatives and connect global themes/trends with opportunities for Dubai.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with legal, policy, strategy, and partnership teams to ensure project compliance and cross\-sector success.
* Documentation: Create and maintain project records, perform lessons\-learned assessments, and present reports to senior management.
* Team Collaboration: Communicate regularly with Sandbox team members and stakeholders to ensure projects run smoothly, providing updates to the Head of Operations and Director of Sandbox Dubai.
* Stakeholder Engagement and Third\-Party Relationships.
* Partner and collaborate with industry leaders, government agencies, startups, and regulatory bodies to align project goals. Ensure regular communication, and logistics are in place.
* Lead workshops, roundtables, and innovation sessions with relevant stakeholders to drive regulatory alignment and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with the Legal, Strategy, and Policy Teams to define regulatory exemptions, licensing terms, and compliance protocols.
* Work closely with finance, procurement and other internal teams to oversee procurement, invoices, and contracts ensuring legal compliance in all transactions.
* Support the development of policy proposals, regulatory models, and whitepapers in collaboration with Policy and Legal Teams.
* Ensure all projects comply with Sandbox governance frameworks, legal protocols, and international regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with the Marketing \& Communications Teams to enhance project visibility through media outreach and branding campaigns.



  





**Why this role is important?** 




  





 This role is central to translating Sandbox Dubai’s regulatory innovation goals into actionable Sandbox projects that drive policy reform, technology adoption and economic competitiveness. Moreover, this role is critical for providing operational management for core Sandbox projects throughout their lifecycle, fostering cross\-sector collaboration, and thus accelerating Dubai’s transformation into a global innovation hub.
 



  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




  





 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





**Skills** 




  




* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Public Policy, Law, Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Artificial Intelligence, or Technology Management. A Master’s degree is preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum of 7 years’ experience in project management, regulatory frameworks, or innovation\-driven programs with a proven track record of multi\-project management.
* **Specialization:** 
 Demonstrated experience in regulatory frameworks related projects, innovation ecosystems, and emerging tech pilots.
* **Industry Expertise:** 
 Experience working with government agencies, private sector entities, international organizations and technology hubs is required. Experience in one or more of the key priority thematic areas (AI/Technology, Healthcare, Infrastructure/Real Estate, or Sustainability) is strongly preferred.
* **Skills required:** 
 Excellent project management skills with high attention to detail and a strong dedication to completing projects within assigned deadlines, ability to multi\-task, coordinating multiple projects concurrently while partnering effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Demonstrable experience in regulatory modernization, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, project development, resource management, as well as using project planning and presentation tools (MS Project, PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI .. etc). Project management certifications (such as PMP/PMI\-Agile/SCRUM) preferred.
* **Communication and Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Strong communication skills are required to effectively manage high\-level stakeholder relationships in public and private sectors and engage multidisciplinary teams. Ability to clearly articulate project updates to Sandbox and DFF leadership as well as external stakeholders, identify challenges, and mobilize cross\-team responses quickly.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluent in reading, writing \& presenting in both Arabic \& English.
* **Mindset:** 
 Agile, proactive, structured, self\-driven, and ready to work independently or as part of a collaborative team, and ability to drive cross\-functional collaboration, manage multiple projects, and meet tight deadlines.

 As a
 **Techno\-Commercial Program Manager**

data.jd_text:
**ROLE OVERVIEW:** 




  





 The AI Factory Development Director is the founding program lead for Magna AI's physical AI infrastructure build. Reporting directly to the AI Factory Partner, this individual owns end\-to\-end delivery of MDC deployments from real estate origination through to operational handover — running simultaneously across GCC/UAE, Africa, and SEA markets. The role is the commercial and operational heartbeat of the AI Factories department, accountable for ensuring every site progresses through Magna AI's milestone sequencing on time, on budget, and to specification.
 



 This is a senior founding position within a lean, high\-performance team of three FTEs. The Director carries the full program lifecycle — LOI progression, EPC contract governance, capex control, and PMO gate compliance — while maintaining tight commercial acumen across a $12–$600M\+ infrastructure capex range. The role demands an operator who can simultaneously manage multiple deployments at different stages while driving anchor tenant relationships from day one.
 



  





**ROLE DETAILS:** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Program Delivery** 



* Lead end\-to\-end program management across all AI Factory and MDC deployments — real estate, procurement, design, build, and operational handover
* Own milestone tracking and stage\-gate progression from pre\-seed through to construction and stabilization phases
* Manage program baseline, variation orders, and cost\-to\-complete forecasting across all active sites
* Drive PMO gate compliance — Capex Control and Technical Governance domains — ensuring no site proceeds without proper gate clearance



**Commercial \& Contract Management** 



* Lead LOI progression with anchor tenants, negotiating Heads of Terms and progressing to EPC and long\-term agreements
* Manage EPC contracts, operator agreements, and vendor negotiations across hardware, civil, and MEP workstreams
* Maintain commercial oversight of power pre\-applications, land option agreements, and grid connection contracts
* Coordinate capex commitments and variation orders; produce budget vs. actual reporting for PMO and Steering Committee



**Stakeholder \& Partner Management** 



* Interface daily with the Hardware Deployment Lead and Commercial Lead; co\-own weekly WSR reporting to PMO
* Represent Magna AI in all EPC, design, and land negotiations — acting as the primary counterparty for site delivery
* Manage platform partner engagement (Magnaverse, Wistron, TSMC GCC/UAE supply chain) at the program level
* Escalate technical deviations, budget overruns (\>5%), and HSEQ events per the PMO escalation protocol within defined timeframes



**Strategy \& Market Entry** 



* Shortlist 3–5 sites per deployment cycle based on anchor tenant LOI demand — customer\-led, not site\-led
* Support market prioritization across GCC/UAE, sub\-Saharan Africa (Technova JV), and SEA based on power availability, connectivity, and customer verticals
* Contribute to the divestiture data room packaging at the 30–36 month full AI Factory stage



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE:** 




  





**Essential Experience** 



* 8–12\+ years in data center, infrastructure, or large\-scale construction program management
* Proven track record delivering 10MW\+ data center or mission\-critical infrastructure projects end\-to\-end
* Deep experience with EPC contract structures, LOI/HoT negotiations, and stage\-gate project governance
* Demonstrable capex management across $50M–$500M\+ infrastructure programs
* Prior experience in GCC, Africa, or SEA markets — regional regulatory and procurement knowledge essential



**Desired Skills** 



* Familiarity with DCIM, BMS, and MDC/containerized data center deployment models is a plus
* Exposure to NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, liquid\-cooling, or AI compute facility design
* Experience interfacing with PE/infrastructure fund investors and SPV structuring processes
* Strong project management skills



**Personal Attributes** 



* Commercially sharp — able to read a contract, hold a vendor, support LOI discussions
* High ownership mentality — operates without a playbook and builds the process while delivering
* Collaborative and direct — works at pace with a small team across multiple time zones
* Clear communicator — capable of presenting program status to board\-level stakeholders and SPV investors



**Growth Mindset** 



* Embraces ambiguity as opportunity — thrives in a founding\-team environment where the structure, process, and playbook are built in real time alongside delivery
* Actively seeks feedback — treats Steering Committee reviews, PMO gate challenges, and investor scrutiny as inputs for continuous improvement, not obstacles
* Learns across disciplines — invests time in understanding the wider ecosystem
* Resilient under setbacks — treats issues as problems to iterate around, not reasons to stall
* Draws on diverse experience — applies lessons from other sectors, geographies, and project types to solve novel AI infrastructure challenges where no direct precedent exists

The Opportunity
   

  

 Responsible for directing Professional and Continuing Education (PaCE) activities, including strategic planning, development, and execution of PaCE programmes, business development, training catalog oversight, and stakeholder engagement, to ensure alignment with market demand, client expectations, and the University’s policies and procedures.
   

  

 The Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic \& Financial
   

  

* Lead the development and monitor the execution of the Department's strategy and align with ZU's strategic objectives, ensuring effective and efficient achievement of departmental operations.
* Oversee the Department’s performance through defined KPIs and targets, and continuously identify and recommend improvements to support the realisation of ZU's strategy.
* Direct the allocation of budget across the Department and ensure full adherence to approved plans and rectify any deviations in a timely manner.
* Provide the relevant organisational unit with consolidated budget input as required, ensuring that the Department’s requirements are appropriately addressed in the overall budget planning process.


 Operational
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of business development strategies to expand B2B and B2C professional training services in line with University’s objectives.
* Lead the establishment of strategic partnerships with industry, government, and community stakeholders to generate revenue, expand reach, and ensure programme sustainability.
* Lead the development of tailored proposals and promotional strategies to position PaCE as a leading provider.
* Direct the development, planning, and internal coordination of full\-scale and customised training programmes to ensure strategic alignment, resource optimisation, and successful delivery of the same.
* Lead the development and delivery of professional education programmes, including short courses, certifications, and hybrid learning models, to meet evolving market demands.
* Lead the engagement with external subject\-matter experts to maintain high\-quality content development and delivery across all training programmes.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised training catalog and digital infrastructure, including LMS platforms, to ensure seamless access to current and upcoming training offerings.
* Direct institutional compliance by ensuring documentation, reporting, and quality assurance mechanisms across all PaCE training activities.
* Direct institutional initiatives that promote faculty and student participation in entrepreneurial training, venture creation, and business incubation programmes offered by the PaCE department.
* Perform ad\-hoc activities related to the job duties, as requested by the direct supervisor.


 People Management
   

  

* Review consolidated workforce planning reports, talent acquisition strategies, and budgets at the Department level to ensure adequate staffing for optimal operational smoothness, and submit to the appropriate authority for final approval.
* Set performance management objectives for all reportees and perform mid\-year and year\-end performance reviews.
* Identify talent for pivotal roles from a succession management standpoint to ensure business continuity.
* Provide guidance to reporting managers on people management matters.
* Manage organisational units within the Department and ensure effective leadership to adequately manage human capital.


 The Requirements
   

  

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience and at least 10 years in a managerial position.
* Certification in a relevant field is preferred.


 The Benefits
   

  

 The University’s benefits package is highly attractive, with competitive tax\-free salaries in the U.A.E., cash housing, annual vacation airline tickets for the employee and immediate family, educational subsidies for children, and healthcare for the employee and sponsored family members.
   

  

 To Apply
   

  

 In addition to completing the online application form, attach a cover letter, a current CV, and the names and contact details of three professional references.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications, you will be contacted only if selected for an interview.
   

  

 For any further inquiries, please contact Recruitment@zu.ac.ae

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a
 **Salesforce Application/Technical Architect (Business Director Level)**
 to lead Salesforce architecture across a portfolio of large\-scale, multi\-cloud transformation engagements. The role operates as a senior architecture authority, with primary accountability for a Unified Contact Centre program for a major enterprise client, and broader responsibility across multiple concurrent client engagements, pre\-sales pursuits, and capability development.
 



  





 The role is hands\-on, program\-level, and client\-facing. It r
 
 equires deep Salesforce architecture expertise across Service Cloud, Data Cloud, and integration patterns, combined with the judgement to make design decisions
 
 that hold up under client technical reviews and operate consistently across workstreams. On the lead engagement, the architect owns end\-to\-end solution integrity across Knowledge Management, Case Management, Customer 360, Data Architecture, and Integrations. Across the wider portfolio, the architect provides architecture leadership, technical assurance, and pre\-sales support.
 



  





 The ideal candidate brings proven multi\-cloud Salesforce architecture experience, the discipline to drive configuration\-first solutions, and the credibility to engage senior client stakeholders on design trade\-offs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Architecture \& Solution Leadership** 



* Own the end\-to\-end Salesforce solution architecture across Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, and integrated platforms.

* Drive design decisions across parallel workstreams and ensure consistency of foundational components (e.g. data model).
* Provide architecture leadership across multiple concurrent client engagements, ensuring design coherence and quality standards are upheld across the portfolio.
* Establish and evolve reusable architecture patterns, reference designs, and accelerators that can be applied across engagements.



**Client Advisory \& Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Act as the senior architecture point of contact for client stakeholders, including business owners across verticals, IT leadership, and operations leads.
* Translate Salesforce capability into business outcomes for non\-technical audiences; translate business requirements into precise technical design for delivery teams.
* Facilitate design workshops, present architecture decisions, and produce client\-ready artifacts.



**Program \& Delivery Oversight** 



* Provide architectural oversight across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring solution coherence and delivery quality.
* Govern technical risks, design debt, and scope changes; escalate trade\-offs with clear options and recommendations.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical assurance across other Salesforce engagements in the portfolio, surfacing risks and design gaps early.



**Pre\-Sales \& Business Development** 



* Lead Salesforce architecture input into pre\-sales opportunities, including discovery sessions, solution shaping, and response authoring.
* Define target\-state solutions, integration approaches, and high\-level estimates that map client requirements to Salesforce capability.
* Present architecture and solution approach to prospective clients in pitches, orals, and technical evaluations.



  





**Required Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 10\+ years in Salesforce delivery, with at least 5 years in a Salesforce architect role on multi\-cloud enterprise programs.
* Proven hands\-on architecture experience across multiple Salesforce clouds.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Salesforce with CTI and other key third\-party platforms.
* Experience supporting pre\-sales activity, including solution shaping, RFP responses, and client\-facing pitches.
* Consulting or agency delivery background; experience delivering in the Middle East market is an advantage.
* Salesforce platform architecture (sharing, security, large data volumes, governor limits, declarative vs programmatic trade\-offs).
* Service Cloud design: Case Management, Knowledge (article taxonomy, lifecycle, approval, versioning), Omnichannel and Skills\-Based Routing and more.
* Integration architecture: REST/SOAP/event\-driven, Platform Events, middleware patterns.
* Knowledge of AI related Salesforce features.
* Governance: release management, environment strategy, DevOps tooling, technical debt management.

With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.

 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
   

  

* Support coordination across multiple teams or workstreams contributing to Gray Space UL deliverables.
* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an accredited institution.


**Skills**
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting data centers, power systems, electrical infrastructure, or regulated product development preferred.
* Familiarity with UL certification processes or safety‑critical product development.
* Experience operating within large, global enterprises.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
   

  

 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
   

  

 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.


**What You Will Need For This Position**
* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.


**Key Metrics**
* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

 GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation.  The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


 A highly visible and customer\-facing position, within the Professional Services organization, and the wider Customer Success team, that works with but not limited to Professional Services Engineers, Project Managers, Engagement Managers, Technical Architects, Professional Services Operations, and the Sales Organization. A Program Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing customer programs and a portfolio of projects. Their primary role is to ensure the successful delivery of client projects, including long\-term strategy, while also managing the overall program and providing strategic guidance to the team and customer. The Professional Services Program Manager reports to the Regional Delivery Manager.

* Lead delivery of multi\-workstream professional services engagements with some of the largest and most strategic customers.
* Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders including executive leaders, counterpart program/project managers, engineering, development, and security and teams.

* Ability to manage budgets and timelines for long\-term projects
* Develop long\-term plans in collaboration with customers

 Remote\-Global

data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




  





 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Real Estate \& Hospitality banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 




  




* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
* Demonstrate understanding of the sector across all RE asset classes
* Originate new business opportunities with new to bank target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Cross collaborate to obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals to expand RE market share
* Anchor Strategic Alliances with UAE’s Top Developers, Authorities, and sector experts
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions, keeping with RE cycles and thematics
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
* Bank's management.

**Key Accountabilities**
* Partner with the Programme Director to deliver the end\-to\-end project lifecycle, achieving key milestones on time and within budget.
* Identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues effectively, producing clear, concise summaries and management\-ready reporting.
* Take a pragmatic, flexible approach to planning and prioritization of tasks, deliverables, and resources, adapt quickly to unforeseen change; apply a test\-and\-learn mindset, recommend better ways of working, and constructively challenge the status quo.
* Manage material changes to scope, schedule, resourcing, or budget through formal change control processes; understand and champion design thinking across ideation and delivery.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of complex business drivers and imperatives, applying critical thinking and structured problem\-solving to bring discipline to large\-scale, ambiguous challenges.
* Build credibility through strong interpersonal skills, translating complex information into clear, influential messages; coordinate across cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to secure timely decisions.
* Drive change adoption to embed outcomes and realize benefits, combining strong programme/project management discipline with pace and quality of delivery.
* Apply deep knowledge of risk and control taxonomy, including identification, ownership, management, and reporting of inherent and residual risks and control positions.
* Own delivery of one or more global transformation projects from initiation to closure, using agreed delivery frameworks (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) and appropriate tooling.
* Define outcomes, success measures, and benefits realization plans; track progress, report transparently, and take corrective action where required.
* Establish and run governance forums (e.g., SteerCo and working groups), producing high\-quality packs, RAID logs, plans, financials, and status reports with clear narrative and explicit decisions required.
* Build strong partnerships across global and regional stakeholders, balancing competing priorities, driving decisions, and maintaining alignment across boundaries.
* Embed risk management and control\-by\-design, ensuring adherence to relevant policies, regulatory expectations, and audit requirements (refer to applicable FIM/departmental instructions as needed).
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans (scope, schedule, resources, budget), manage dependencies and critical path, and drive execution at pace.
* Partner with Change, Communications, and Training teams to deliver adoption, readiness, and sustainable change, managing impacts to operating model, processes, and people.
* Manage budgets, forecasts, and (where applicable) vendor spend, ensuring value for money and transparent cost control.
* Lead matrix teams, coach contributors, and foster a collaborative, inclusive environment that values different perspectives and delivers results.
* Continuously improve delivery practices by simplifying, standardizing, and automating where possible; capturing lessons learned and embedding improvements.


 In order to apply for the role you must have the following:
   

  

* A graduation degree is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. If your university certificate is from outside the UAE, up\-to\-date attestations and equivalency are also mandatory (Recognition of Higher Education Qualifications Issued Outside The UAE) Demonstrated track record delivering large\-scale, multi\-workstream transformations within global, regulated environments.
* Strong capability in project governance, integrated planning, RAID management, and executive\-level reporting.
* Highly effective stakeholder manager, able to secure decisions and maintain alignment across matrix organizations.
* Sound understanding of financial services risk and control expectations.
* Strong analytical skills, translating strategy into executable plans with clear, measurable outcomes.
* Confident communicator—clear, concise, and able to tailor messages to different audiences and levels of seniority.
* Experience delivering operating model change, process re\-engineering (Lean/Six Sigma), and/or digital transformation.
* Familiar with Agile delivery approaches (Scrum/Kanban) and hybrid delivery models.
* Exposure to data\-led initiatives, automation, and/or platform migration programmes.
* Extensive project management experience, with evidence of delivering complex change, managing senior stakeholders, and working effectively across regions and functions.


 For further details and application information please visit our careers site, searching for reference number
 **45067** 
 .
   

  

 We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 As a PM on the Supply Chain Automation team, you'll design and build full\-stack applications and data\-intensive systems that power critical supply chain decisions. You'll work with massive datasets, develop and implement science\-based artifacts capable to impact broader supply chain, and create intuitive interfaces that enable our operations teams to work smarter and faster.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, develop, and deploy full\-stack applications for supply chain optimization and automation
   

  

 Build scalable backend services using modern technologies (Java, Python, Node.js, etc.) on AWS infrastructure
   

  

 Develop responsive, performant frontend applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Redux, and modern web technologies
   

  

 Architect and implement data pipelines leveraging our lakehouse architecture with Apache Iceberg
   

  

 Work with large\-scale data systems including Amazon Redshift, S3, and EMR
   

  

 Perform data mining and analysis to uncover insights that drive supply chain improvements
   

  

 Develop and support scientific solutions that are exemplary in terms of design, clarity, extensibility, and the ability to evolve over time
   

  

 Innovate with the latest technology to build highly automated solutions for efficient forecasting and supply chain automation
   

  

 Design, develop and deploy end\-to\-end machine learning solutions in the Amazon production environment to improvise the current supply chain through forecasting
   

  

 Own the full software development lifecycle from design to deployment and operations
   

  

 Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to technical strategy
   

  

**About The Team**
 Join Amazon's Supply Chain Automation team, chartered with building the next generation of automation and optimization systems from the ground up. Our mission is to transform supply chain operations through intelligent automation, reducing manual effort while increasing speed, accuracy, and efficiency across Amazon's fulfillment network.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 2\+ years of software development experience
* 3\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust
* Experience designing rich user interfaces using modern web frameworks (such as React, Angular, and Vue)
* Knowledge of object\-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit\-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
* Experience effectively gathering information from multiple data sources
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS


**Preferred Qualifications**
