data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

* Originating, structuring and executing new deals along with the coverage \& credit team.

**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.
* Liaise with Ministries of Education and local education councils.
* Develop data\-driven, multi\-year enrollment projection scenarios to establish capacity parameters and budgetary requirements.
* Monitor and assess the growth of the external student sponsorship program and strengthen relationships with sponsoring organizations.
* Represent the university at media events and on\- and off\-campus recruitment functions.
* Develop a recruitment and new\-student communications plan, guiding prospects from initial inquiry through matriculation.
* Develop and implement, in consultation with the recruitment team, an annual comprehensive recruitment campaign plan.
* Co\-manage, with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department, the development of communication plans and the implementation of promotional tools for recruitment campaigns (e.g., social media, advertising).
* Engage colleges/schools, faculty, alumni, and various AUS departments in recruitment efforts to achieve enrollment goals.
* Establish partnership agreements with select high schools locally and internationally to attract highly qualified applicants.
* Lead the integration of automation and artificial intelligence solutions to enhance enrollment operations, improve applicant experience, increase efficiency, and transition key processes from manual to data\-driven digital workflows.


**Qualifications And Skills Required**
* Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of the higher education landscape, including emerging trends, regulatory frameworks, and best practices in enrollment management.
* Solid background in developing and implementing admissions policies, academic credential evaluation standards, and related governance frameworks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.


**How To Apply**

* AUS is an equal opportunity employer. We adhere to a policy of making employment decisions without regard to race, color, age, gender, religion, national origin, disability or marital status. Opportunities for employment are based solely upon one’s qualifications.

data.jd_text:
**About Edenred**
 Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.
   

  

 Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.
   

  

 Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi\-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.
   

  

 True to the Group's purpose, "Enrich connections. For good.", these solutions enhance users' well\-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.
   

  

 Edenred’s 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
   

  

 In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.
   

  

 Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.
   

  

**THE UAE CONTEXT**
 Edenred UAE is a fast growing payroll service provider serving more than 15,000 business and more than 2\.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions. We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll and for employees to receive their salaries and use it in the simplest way offering multiple value added services via our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge and card services)
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 The MLRO is primarily responsible for managing the identification, investigation, and reporting of suspicious activities related to money laundering and financial crime. This role leads the preparation and submission of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs/STRs) to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and submit reports and AdHoc regulatory reports, conducts thorough investigations of flagged transactions, and supports the Risk Manager in conducting regular AML risk assessments. The MLRO serves as the main liaison with regulatory authorities on AML matters, supports policy maintenance, and provides senior management and the Board with clear reporting on AML program effectiveness. Additionally, the MLRO collaborates with the broader compliance team to ensure strong internal controls and supports AML training initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR/STR): Receiving, investigating, and reporting suspicious internal transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and relevant regulators in a timely and accurate manner.
* Investigation Management: Conduct thorough investigations into flagged transactions or activities, documenting findings and determining appropriate next steps.
* Risk Assessment: Support the Risk Manager by contributing to regular, organization\-wide AML risk assessments to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities to financial crime.
* Regulatory Liaison: Act as the main point of contact for regulatory authorities regarding AML matters, managing inquiries, providing required documentation, and supporting audits.
* Policy and Procedure Maintenance: Maintain and update AML policies, procedures, and internal controls to reflect current laws, regulations, and evolving risks.
* Reporting to Board: Provide clear and regular reports on the effectiveness of the AML program, suspicious activity trends, and risk assessments to senior management and the Board.
* Training Support: Assist in delivering AML training and awareness initiatives related to suspicious activity identification and reporting.
* Collaborate closely with the Compliance Lead, Director, and other stakeholders to support overall compliance and risk mitigation strategies.


 AML Tools and Systems Familiarity:
   

  

* Transaction Monitoring Systems (e.g., NICE Actimize, FICO TONBELLER, Oracle Mantas, SAS AML)
* Sanctions Screening Tools (e.g., World\-Check, Dow Jones Risk \& Compliance, LexisNexis Bridger Insight)
* Customer Due Diligence (CDD)/KYC Platforms (e.g., ComplyAdvantage, IdentityMind, Onfido, Trulioo)
* Case Management Systems (e.g., AML RightSource, CaseWare, Actimize AML Case Manager)
* Regulatory Reporting Tools integrated with FIUs or regulatory portals
* Experience with data analysis and business intelligence tools such as SQL, Tableau, or Power BI is a plus.


**YOUR PROFILE**
* Minimum of 5 PQE
* Proven AML experience, particularly in SAR/STR reporting and investigations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of AML regulations, FIU reporting requirements, and financial crime typologies.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills with attention to detail.
* CAMS Certified
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.


**REPORTING STRUCTURE:**
 The selected candidate will report directly to CLCO and Board of Directors.
   

  

**COLLABORATION:**
 The candidate will collaborate with Compliance Director, Risk Manager, legal, audit teams, and business units in charge of processes.

At Genius we are hiring for a role of
 **Manager Operations\-\-Home Delivery** 
 for a leading FMCG client
 



**Location Dubai** 




 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Delivery Operations Management
 


* Oversee and manage end\-to\-end delivery operations across all outlets and brands.
* Ensure compliance with company standards, food safety regulations, and operational procedures.
* Maintain delivery infrastructure readiness, including staffing, systems, packaging, and logistics processes.
* Monitor and improve operational KPIs including SLA adherence, delivery delays, cancellations, refunds, customer ratings, and order accuracy.
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks in coordination with outlet management teams.
* Conduct regular operational audits to ensure consistency and service excellence.



 2\. Aggregator \& Partner Management
 


* Manage relationships with third\-party delivery aggregators and logistics partners.
* Negotiate commercial terms, commissions, service level agreements (SLAs), and partnership conditions.
* Monitor promotional campaigns, marketing activities, and platform visibility.
* Optimize advertising spend, discount structures, and promotional ROI.
* Ensure partner compliance and resolve operational or technical issues promptly.



 3\. Sales, Marketing \& Growth
 


* Drive delivery sales growth and profitability across all brands and markets.
* Plan and execute delivery\-focused marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Analyze campaign performance and implement strategies to maximize ROI.
* Support the development and expansion of dark kitchens and virtual brands.
* Optimize menu engineering, pricing strategies, and product availability to maximize revenue.



 4\. Customer Experience Management
 


* Manage and resolve escalated customer complaints related to delivery operations.
* Monitor customer feedback trends and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate documentation, tracking, and resolution of customer feedback and service issues.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and service quality standards.



 5\. Reporting \& Analytics
 


* Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly operational and commercial reports.
* Analyze sales performance, delivery KPIs, customer behavior, and operational trends.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for business improvement.
* Develop dashboards and performance tracking mechanisms to support data\-driven decision\-making.



 6\. Compliance \& Quality Assurance
 


* Ensure adherence to company policies, operational standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular audits and compliance checks across all delivery operations.
* Maintain and improve quality assurance processes to ensure consistent service standards.



 7\. Contract Management
 


* Manage contracts and agreements with delivery aggregators, logistics providers, and external partners.
* Track contract renewals, compliance obligations, and commercial performance.
* Ensure all agreements align with company objectives and operational requirements.



 8\. Strategic Planning \& Expansion
 


* Support new outlet openings, market expansions, and brand launches.
* Conduct feasibility studies and operational assessments for new delivery initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to long\-term delivery growth strategies and business development initiatives.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Delivery sales and order growth
* SLA and delivery time adherence
* Customer satisfaction and ratings
* Order accuracy and cancellation rates
* Refund and complaint reduction
* Cost control and operational efficiency
* Campaign performance and ROI
* Aggregator relationship performance
* Profitability of delivery operations



 Qualifications \& Requirements
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in delivery operations, food service, QSR, or multi\-unit operations management.
* Strong understanding of delivery aggregators, food delivery platforms, and logistics operations.
* Proven experience in KPI management, sales growth, and operational optimization.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and operational dashboards.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-market environment.

**About IC Markets** 




 IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.
 



 IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.
 



 Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross\-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high\-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi\-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Cross\-Team Dependency \& Complex Delivery Management** 



* Own and drive resolution of cross\-team technical dependencies across 8–12\+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme\-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi\-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter\-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform\-level dependencies across squads



  





**Delivery \& Release Governance** 



* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large\-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no\-go criteria, and sign\-off processes
* Oversee end\-to\-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization



  





**Technical Programme Leadership** 



* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross\-team planning, and programme\-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity
* Drive PI Planning and large\-scale increment coordination across product and platform squads



  





**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary delivery interface for senior stakeholders, CTO, and executive leadership on complex programmes
* Produce clear, data\-driven programme status reports, risk dashboards, and delivery forecasts for leadership review
* Translate complex technical interdependencies into business\-level impact narratives for non\-technical audiences
* Proactively manage expectations, surface trade\-offs, and recommend delivery options under constraint.



  





**Tooling \& Delivery Intelligence** 



* Own and evolve programme\-level Jira structures including epics hierarchies, dependency links, cross\-project boards, and automation
* Drive delivery intelligence through advanced metrics: cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, dependency resolution SLAs.
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that surface programme health, risk, and delivery confidence
* Ensure tooling practices support audit readiness and compliance requirements in a regulated financial services environment



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* 10\+ years in Technical Delivery Management, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership roles
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi\-team technical programmes in a regulated or high\-stakes environment
* Deep expertise in cross\-team dependency management across large engineering organizations (8\+ teams)
* Strong technical fluency; ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects, and platform teams on technical trade\-offs
* Extensive experience with Agile at scale frameworks and hybrid delivery models
* Advanced Jira administration, programme\-level workflow design, and delivery metrics expertise
* Proven experience driving complex release governance across distributed, parallel workstreams
* Experience working in fintech, trading platforms, or high\-frequency, regulated product environments strongly preferred
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast\-paced, high\-complexity environment

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Be responsible for driving delivery of large scale internal development and vendor tender across Emirates Network Operations. The environment is fast paced, with tight timelines and high operational impact. The focus is on delivering internally built systems as well as tendering for a large vendor implementations.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**
 The Customer Support Executive – EMEA is a customer facing operational role within the Sales \& Commercial function at Skyways Technics’ Dubai (DXB) hub. The role is the primary point of contact for EMEA region customers throughout the order lifecycle, from Purchase Order receipt through to delivery and post sales resolution while ensuring a consistently high quality buying experience that reflects Skyways Technics’ commitment to service excellence. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, commercially aware, and skilled at managing multiple concurrent transactions in a fast paced aviation aftermarket environment, while building strong, trust based relationships with customers and internal teams alike.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Order Management \& Customer Liaison**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for EMEA customers upon receipt of Purchase Orders (POs), ensuring prompt acknowledgement, accurate processing, and proactive communication throughout the order lifecycle.
* Support Sales Managers in all aspects of order processing, administration, and follow up activities, ensuring orders are executed accurately and on time.
* Monitor open orders and flag potential delays, discrepancies, or fulfilment risks to the relevant Sales Manager at the earliest opportunity.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of each customer’s order requirements, urgency levels (including AOG situations), and preferred communication protocols.
* Ensure all customer interactions by phone, email, and all platforms are handled professionally, responsively, and in line with Skyways Technics’ service standards.


**Logistics Coordination \& Shipment Management**
* Coordinate with internal departments and external logistics providers to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant shipment and delivery of all customer orders.
* Track shipment status across all open orders, providing proactive updates to customers and escalating delays or exceptions to the relevant Sales Manager.
* Ensure all shipping documentation, including airworthiness release certificates, packing lists, commercial invoices, and export documentation are accurate, complete, and dispatched with each shipment.
* Coordinate AOG and priority shipments with urgency, liaising with logistics partners to secure the fastest available routing and ensuring customers are kept informed throughout.


**Post Sales Support \& Warranty Management**
* Provide comprehensive post sales support, including coordination of replacement orders, return authorisations, and shipment follow up to ensure full customer satisfaction.
* Monitor and actively follow up on all open warranty cases in coordination with the relevant Sales Manager or Sales team member, ensuring cases are tracked to resolution within agreed timelines.
* Liaise with the technical and quality teams as required to support the investigation and resolution of warranty claims, customer complaints, and return to vendor cases.
* Maintain accurate records of all post sales activities, warranty case status, and customer feedback, ensuring visibility across the commercial team.


**Reporting \& Data Management**
* Prepare, maintain, and distribute weekly reports on open core unit transactions, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery to relevant internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate and up to date records of all customer orders, shipment statuses, warranty cases, and post sales activities within the company’s ERP system (Pentagon 2000\).
* Support the Sales Manager and Commercial Director with ad\-hoc reporting, data compilation, and commercial analysis as required.
* Identify and flag recurring trends or systemic issues in order fulfilment, shipping, or customer feedback, contributing to continuous process improvement.


**Internal Coordination \& Operational Support**
* Act as the operational bridge between customers, Sales Managers, the Stores department, logistics providers, and the finance team to ensure seamless order execution.
* Support the broader sales and commercial team with ad\-hoc tasks and additional responsibilities as required to ensure smooth business operations and timely project completion.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of customer support processes, tools, and communication standards within the EMEA commercial function.
* Ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with applicable company procedures, quality standards, and UAE regulatory requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Aviation Management, Supply Chain, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a customer support, sales coordination, or order management role, within the aviation aftermarket, aerospace, or MRO industry.
* Experience handling aviation spare parts transactions, including familiarity with airworthiness documentation (e.g. EASA Form 1, FAA 81303, CoC) is a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage high volumes of concurrent orders and customer interactions with accuracy and professionalism.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word); hands on experience with ERP systems, preferably Pentagon 2000, is advantageous.
* Experience working in a fast paced, multicultural commercial environment; prior exposure to EMEA customer bases is preferred.
* Must be based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, United Arab Emirates.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple open orders, shipments, and warranty cases simultaneously without loss of accuracy or urgency.
* Customer first mindset and consistently delivers a professional, responsive, and solution focused experience that builds long term trust with EMEA customers
* Clear and effective communicator in English (written and spoken); proficiency in Arabic or other EMEA languages is a significant advantage.
* Detail oriented with high standards of data accuracy across order records, shipping documentation, ERP entries, and customer reporting.
* Collaborative team player who works effectively with Sales Managers, Stores, logistics partners, and finance to ensure seamless order fulfilment.
* Commercially aware and understands the urgency and commercial implications of order delays, AOG situations, and warranty escalations in the aviation context.
* Proactive and self motivated, with the ability to identify issues early, flag them promptly, and follow through to resolution with minimal supervision.
* Adaptable and resilient under pressure, maintaining accuracy and professionalism during peak periods and high urgency situations.

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.  If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

data.jd_text:
**Deliveroo: A DoorDash Company:** 
 Deliveroo’s mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders. Following our successful 2025 merger with DoorDash, we have solidified our position as the global leader in local commerce. This partnership has expanded our footprint to over 45 markets and gives us access to industry\-leading technology and resources. It is a defining moment for our New Verticals business, specifically our 1P delivery\-only sites, Editions and HOP. We are no longer just a delivery app; we are building the infrastructure for the future of instant retail. There has never been a more exciting time to join the 'Roo family' as we integrate with the DoorDash ecosystem to redefine what is possible in the UAE and beyond.
   

  

**New Verticals \& Site Operations:** 
 As part of the DoorDash group, our New Verticals team is the primary global engine for testing and scaling the next generation of first party (1P) retail and automated logistics. We don't just facilitate orders; we own the sites that make them happen. While others act as simple aggregators, we own the infrastructure and the operations to ensure a premium, hyper\-fast experience.
   

  

* Deliveroo Editions: The world's first delivery\-only kitchens. We provide the specialised infrastructure and operational expertise that allow our restaurant partners to scale instantly.
* Deliveroo HOP: Our 1P speedy grocery service. We own the inventory, the technology, and the end\-to\-end fulfilment process to deliver groceries in as little as 15 minutes.


**The Role:** 
 The Regional Manager oversees the end\-to\-end operations of our proprietary, 1P delivery\-only sites across the UAE, spanning both our restaurant (Editions) and retail (HOP) verticals. This is a high\-impact leadership role that balances "boots\-on\-the\-ground" operational rigour with mid\-to\-long\-term strategic decision\-making. As the primary owner of these sites, you will be responsible for all of 1P success: Uncompromised safety, perfect stock integrity, and lightning\-fast throughput.
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Excellence**
 You will drive the business forward by optimising productivity, achieving site personnel cost targets, and minimising wastage/shrinkage. You must be a "Total Ownership" leader; comfortable working strategically to enhance our operating model within the global DoorDash ecosystem while fostering a positive, collaborative, and high\-performance culture for all site colleagues. Below are the 3 key areas this role is expected to manage:
   

  

* Site Governance: Set the "drumbeat" for the region by driving KPIs and supervising compliance with Standard Operating Procedures through impactful coaching.
* Site Presence: Maintain a constant physical presence at sites to ensure a "founder’s mindset" regarding cleanliness, efficiency, and quality.
* Safety \& Compliance: Act as the lead for regional regulatory relationships, ensuring 100% compliance with Dubai Municipality (DM), ADAFSA, etc.


**Financial \& Data Stewardship**
* P\&L Management: Manage the operational lines of the P\&L, tightly controlling labor and OpEx while minimising all forms of wastage/shrinkage.
* WBR/MBR Reporting: Host and participate in Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews. You will produce high\-quality, data\-driven written inputs that articulate regional performance and clear bridges with action plans.


**People \& Strategy**
* Team Development: Recruit, onboard, and mentor a high\-performing Area Manager team, managing the full organisational life cycle from talent development to HR/ER cases.
* Stakeholder Management: Own and champion relationships with host brand partners, site owners, and senior leadership within the wider DoorDash/Deliveroo business.
* Innovation: Lead projects and pilots aimed at testing the next generation of 1P retail and automated logistics.


**Requirements**
* Industry Leadership: Minimum of 3–4 years of F\&B, FMCG, or Grocery experience, with a proven track record in Area or Regional Management.
* Operational Ownership: While direct experience in a 1P environment is a significant advantage, it is essential you demonstrate a "Total Ownership" mindset. This means you are comfortable being the final point of accountability for site standards, stock accuracy, and the seamless hand\-off from inbound receiving to last\-mile dispatch.
* Rigorous Cost Control: Expert at managing and influencing the P\&L with a focus on operational expenditure. You possess the ability to identify inefficiencies and manage labor\-to\-order ratios effectively.
* Strong Writing \& Communication: Ability to craft concise, insightful narratives for WBR and MBR reports, translating raw data into "the why" and "the how" for senior leadership.
* Analytical \& Tech\-Savvy: Data\-driven decision\-maker with a high comfort level in numbers.
* Adaptability \& Autonomy: The grit to define how your role is best achieved in a fast\-paced, evolving environment with high levels of autonomy.
* People Leadership: Excellent ability to influence senior stakeholders while motivating a multi\-national, diverse site\-level workforce.
* Project Management: Capability to lead complex, cross\-functional projects from conception to completion.


**UAE Regulatory Knowledge (Preferred):** 
 Familiarity with navigating inspections and compliance requirements for DM, ADAFSA, and Civil Defence.

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a Resident Architect to join our DSA team in Dubai.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview**




  





 To lead the on\-site architectural supervision and consultant services for major construction projects. This includes the administration of post\-contract responsibilities as defined by the appointment, managing and coordinating multidisciplinary site teams where applicable, ensuring alignment with the approved design intent, and monitoring compliance with the project’s contract, codes, and specifications. When appointed in a Design Guardian capacity, the role is limited to safeguarding the design intent through review, coordination, and advisory input only, and does not include construction supervision, inspection, certification, contract administration, or Defects Liability Period services unless expressly agreed and appointed under a separate scope. The role serves as a primary interface between the client, contractors, design teams, and other stakeholders. The exact scope of services may differ on a project\-by\-project basis and will be further defined as part of the project\-specific deliverables..
 



  





**2\.Job Accountabilities Linked To Objectives**




  





 The Resident Architect is responsible for leading the on\-site project team and driving the successful delivery of the project. As the most senior project representative for DSA on site, this role carries the critical responsibility of safeguarding the company’s interests, contractual, legal, and commercial responsibilities throughout the construction phase and ensuring the project aligns with DSA’s standards and obligations.
 



  





 The Resident Architect may be assigned responsibilities across one or multiple projects, as well as strategic or special initiatives aligned with the company's broader objectives. These special assignments may extend beyond project\-specific duties and can include tasks such as conducting quality audits, developing procedures, manuals and supporting internal process improvements \& development.
 



  





 In all cases, the Resident Architect is expected to work closely, not only with their direct team/ the Client but also with their immediate supervisor and line manager to clearly define the scope of responsibilities, deliverables, and resource requirements specific to each assignment. The final scope of duties and level of authority will be established in consultation with and subject to approval by the Site Operations Director, Project Director or relevant senior leadership.
 



  





**A. Design Site Leadership** 




 • Lead the site\-based lead consultancy team (where present) to ensure high standards of quality, compliance, coordination, and delivery across all stakeholders, proactively addressing deficiencies as they arise.
 



 • Oversee and assist with design deliverables, pre\-engineering, shop drawings, RFIs, submittals, inspections, and construction queries to support timely resolution and adherence to project requirements.
 



 • Review and approve works, including but not limited to mock\-ups, sample rooms, materials, and finishes, ensuring alignment with the approved design / designer, specifications, and project requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective design coordination across all disciplines and contribute to the resolution of design and construction\-related conflicts.
 



 • Conduct regular architectural and design\-focused site walks to monitor the implementation of the approved design intent, including look, feel, materiality, and spatial quality.
 



 • Identify, document, and report design, aesthetic, and quality\-related risks or non\-compliances to the LDC / Client through structured observations and reporting.
 



 • Prepare and issue monthly architectural / design guardianship reports summarising site observations, key risks, and matters requiring attention.
 



 • Review and provide comments on material samples, mock\-ups, mood boards, finishes, look \& feel assessments, and sample rooms to support alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Provide architectural and interior design clarifications, including aesthetic and design intent matters, where requested by the Client.
 



 • Participate in value engineering and design development discussions, providing input on architectural quality, aesthetic impact, and alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Coordinate closely with PMCM, the Contractor, and the wider consultant team during site reviews, technical meetings, and design discussions to maintain alignment between design intent, construction execution, and client expectations.
 



 • Monitor that the executed works reflect the approved design, client expectations, and applicable codes and regulations throughout the construction process.
 



 • Ensure RFIs, approvals, instructions, and IFC changes are managed through the established project communication and authority channels and are properly coordinated across all parties.
 



 • Produce and issue timely internal and external dashboards capturing progress, quality, design alignment, and emerging risks.
 



  





**B. Site Supervision Team Management** 




 • Direct and manage the day\-to\-day performance of DSA's site supervision team (architects, engineers, inspectors, sub\-consultants and the like).
 



 • Ensure all team members are properly briefed on their roles and responsibilities.
 



 • Implement structured delegation and reporting mechanisms.
 



 • Conduct periodic audits, QA/QC / technical reviews, and performance assessments.
 



 • Maintain a collaborative, professional, and high\-performing supervision environment on site.
 



 • Ensure employees / team members conduct are upheld to the highest standards
 



 • Monitor and update in coordination with the Client and Site Operations Director the project, staff deployment, associated schedule and ensure timely delivery of the same at the agreed frequency
 



  





**C. Project \& Contract Administration** 




 • Oversee compliance with the project’s construction contract (FIDIC or equivalent).
 



 • Issue formal communications, manage variations, evaluate contractor claims, and contribute to extension of time assessments.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation, records \& communication protocols are established, used and maintained for all supervision activities.
 



 • Coordinate with the Employer’s Representative and Client\-appointed Consultants.
 



 • Act as Engineer’s Representative / Employer’s Representative if appointed, ensuring responsibilities are discharged in line with the delegated authority.
 



 • Assist in stake holder and lead in team dispute resolution
 



  





**D. Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Interface** 




 • Act as the senior site representative of the lead consultant.
 



 • Establish and manage coordination mechanisms among the consultant team, contractor, suppliers, and client representatives.
 



 • Participate in progress meetings, site coordination meetings, and technical reviews.
 



 • Monitor and steer project progress and associated scheduling and produce relevant reports
 



 • Provide strategic input and advice to the client to ensure project objectives are met.
 



  





**E. Quality \& Compliance Oversight** 




 • Enforce quality control standards and escalate issues that risk the design quality or compliance of the project / deliverables
 



 • Monitor health, safety, and environmental practices on site.
 



 • Participate in final inspections, testing, and commissioning phases.
 



 • Ensure defect lists, non\-conformance reports and site observations are compiled and rectified in line with contract obligations.
 



 • Ensure pre\-engineering deliverables are in line with contract agreement and implement measures to maintain and or rectify resulting shortfalls
 



 • Monitor and advise on change control process
 



  





**F. Leadership \& Mentorship** 




 • Serve as mentor and technical advisor to staff, engineers and sub\-consultants.
 



 • Lead internal training and onboarding of new site staff.
 



 • Foster a knowledge\-sharing culture that emphasizes continuous improvement and professional development to the benefit of the project and company.
 



  





**G. Commercial \& Invoicing Responsibilities** 




 • Coordinate with the head office/accounts team to prepare and validate monthly consultancy service invoices in line with contract terms.
 



 • Review and confirm site\-based and related staff, timesheets for inclusion in monthly billing.
 



 • Collect, verify, and consolidate sub\-consultant timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and scope alignment.
 



 • Track sub\-consultant invoices and ensure timely submission to accounts for processing.
 



 • Maintain a project\-specific log of all invoicing activities, including issue dates, payment terms, and receipt confirmations amongst others.
 



 • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with clients and relevant stakeholders to ensure prompt payment.
 



 • Flag and escalate delays in payment or disputed invoices to the Project Director and commercial team.
 



 • Liaise with sub\-consultants regarding their payment status and provide updates on payment cycles and client approvals.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal financial procedures and contractual invoicing requirements.
 



 • Support monthly project \& financial reporting with updates on invoice status, forecasted income, and payment risks.
 



 • Assist in reconciling client payment records with internal accounts to resolve discrepancies, if any.
 



 • Track any approved variations or scope changes and coordinate with the commercial team to ensure these are invoiced accordingly.
 



  





**3\. Qualification / Experience / Requirements**

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of your Day**
 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project teams and be involved during the sales phase. You will organize all procurement activities in a project under optimum deployment of resources. You also implement procurement strategies aiming to optimize project results, including availability of goods and services in quality, in time, in budget while ensuring observance of obligatory Procurement processes and regulations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Early Involvement during sales phase: Analyze sales and operations planning in respect of starting/new projects in order to ensure the involvement of Procurement. Participate in project/sales meetings as project core team member to provide information about supply market, preferred suppliers and supplier innovation (regarding goods and services) at an early stage to optimize supplier strategy and selection of Major CTO and ETO equipment, such as Motors, Gears, Gas Engines, Acoustics equipment, Auxiliaries (Lube Systems, Gas Seal panels, etc); diversified components (Dry Gas Seals, Anti\-Surge Valves, other); extended scope such as WHRU, HRSG, Balance of Plant.
* Project Procurement standards: Establish proper sourcing processes, control all Procurement resources and activities in the project and inform all involved within Procurement to deliver optimum impact for the business (Procurement plan, target\-costing) relating to budget, availability, timeline and quality. Apply Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organization standards and PM@Siemens Energy
* Analysis: Analyze scope of supply, contractual obligations and exactly understand customer’s functional needs.Identify Procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims and market forces during the entire project, together with Commodity Management, to avoid potential damage / exploit potential.
* Strategy definition and implementation: Derive Procurement strategy for assigned projects in accordance with Business Unit \& Operating Company Procurement strategies and ensure implementation. Introduce negotiation recommendations together with Commodity Management to prepare for negotiations with suppliers (back\-to\-back where appropriate) and to initiate appropriate measures.
* Negotiation: Lead complex contractual and price, cash flow and commercial T\&C negotiations and/or support the specialist buyers responsible for particular material fields (in particular those not covered by any Commodity Management) to secure project targets with optimum conditions on the basis of ToCO.
* Contract Management: Ensure that major Procurement risks, changes to original scope of supply and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are covered in valid contracts. Ensure that contractual obligations (towards the customer that must be fulfilled by supplier) are covered in a way that mitigates the own risk exposure.
* Supplier Management / Preferred Supplier List: Apply preferred supplier list (e.g. FPL), provide supplier information to the project team, coordinate Supplier Management in preparation for transition to Project execution phase (including Supplier Qualification, project\-specific supplier evaluations and supplier development).
* Knowledge management and documentation: Be proactive and forward systematically all relevant Procurement related project information (e.g. updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross\-functional partners up to date. Share best practice and conduct lessons learn sessions. Sensitize cross\-functional partners for Procurement related practices processes and metrics.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in an engineering discipline with minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or M.S. degree in engineering discipline with 3 years of relevant experience; or M.B.A with technical B.S. degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent education and experience.
* Compression and/or Gas Turbine major equipment relevant technical proficiency preferred
* 5 Years experience minimum combined in related SCM functions, Project Procurement, Proposal and/or Project Management within Oil and Gas or Power Generation industry.
* Advanced MS Office applications skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
* Advanced knowledge of sourcing process
* Advanced negotiation skills
* Good problem solving skills
* Cost Modeling
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Advanced data analytics
* Leader, self\-manage
* Ability to run presentations to management level
* Availability to travel estimated 15% of time


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs

 Luxury Aluminium Systems / Windows \& Doors / Architectural Glazing

 My client is seeking a Technical Installation Project Manager to oversee the delivery and installation of high\-end aluminium window, sliding door, and glazing systems across luxury residential and commercial projects in the UAE.
 



  





 The role will manage site execution from pre\-installation coordination through to final handover, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, to specification, and to premium quality standards expected within the luxury villa and architectural glazing market.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge of aluminium systems, façade/glazing installation, and experience managing installation teams on high\-end construction projects in the GCC.

* Manage full installation lifecycle of aluminium windows, doors, curtain wall, and glazing systems.

 PM will be working as an integral part of the Middle Projects team, the PM can be remotely based. During installation and commisionning phase the PM will have to travel to the site up to 100% of his time depending on the project phase and customer request. The chosen person will work in close collaboration with the Site Manager.

* Identify and maintain a risk register, while actively working to mitigate and/or eliminate potential problems.
* Lead needs with Eaton internal engineering teams to align on the definition of deliverables as per technical specification and customer requirements. For that electrical background is a must and knowledge of datacenter environment is a plus
* Identify supplier needs and coordinate with supply chain for new supplier qualification, and ensure competitiveness of the solution
* Responsible for controlling and supporting the field operations tasks with respect to EHS, scope, schedule and quality. The Site manager and Site coordinator is functionally reporting to the PM
* Continually identify ways to improve the way Eaton execute projects and share learning. This may involve developing new initiatives and recommending better ways to work based on analysis and learning on sites as well as overall customer trends.
* Site assignment can be necessary during the installation and commisionning activities


**Qualifications**
* A Bachelors’ Degree or Masters' Degree or equivalent with a bias towards electrical engineering. Accredited Project Management qualifications with a construction site bias in Electrical engineering.
* An electrical engineering background with design and installations experience of heavy duty power distribution is essential for this role, ideally in Datacenters or similar critical systems applications
* Minimum of 5 years construction site management experience plus an equivalent of hands\-on site works in Data Centers is expected. Experience with other large and complex industrial projects will also be considered, especially if the fields of automation and controls.
* A strong electrical background and/or training on datacenter technologies and systems is expected.
* Direct experience of electrical engineering, Power Management, Power Control, Mission Critical or Building Management and controls systems.
* Advanced\-level role with a preference for someone with knowledge of the datacenter industry or similar technologies


**Our Offer**
* Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry
* Work in a company that is commitment to Inclusion \& Diversity and Sustainability
* Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system
* Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide
* Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally
* Strong processes and state\-of\-the\-art systems and tools
* Structured employee development processes, open feedback culture with development plans
* Detailed induction support and well\-structured onboarding


 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

*Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*
 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

data.jd_text:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.
